title: Structure-based virtual screening with AlphaFold identifies CLIP1-LTK inhibitors.
summary: The structure-guided pipeline and analog search yielded an inhibitor tested biochemically, in cells and in xenografts. Evidence is preclinical; AI did not perform every selection step.
organization: Zhejiang University; First Affiliated Hospital Zhejiang University; Soochow University

evidence.tested: The structure-guided pipeline and analog search yielded an inhibitor tested biochemically, in cells and in xenografts. Evidence is preclinical; AI did not perform every selection step.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3 structure-prediction models is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
